format_classification.note: format states HOW a subject is written, not WHY it exists. role/owner/load-mechanism is PR-5a-2 and is deliberately absent here. A generic parser must select behaviour from this field and must never assume .conf implies simple assignment.
format_classification.nft_ruleset_note: v1.230.0 PR-5a-2: /etc/nftban/nftables.conf is a shipped runtime config subject written as an nft ruleset (#!/usr/sbin/nft -f), consumed by the nft binary, not by the generic assignment parser, which correctly refuses it as UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT. It had NO registry entry while the R-1 source predicate could not see install/nftables/ at all.

key_semantics_authority: config-schema.json — single authority for deprecated/renamed/type/default/active_when. The duplicate deprecated_keys and renamed_keys maps were removed in v1.230.0 PR-5a-1 after data-flow verification showed zero jq/field extractions anywhere in the tree.
key_convention: files[] is keyed by INSTALLED path relative to /etc/nftban, not by source path. install/config/* subjects are registered under the path packaging installs them to (build_nftban.sh:569,594,2468,2484) and carry source_path. Keying discovery on the source tree created three duplicate entries in v1.230.0 PR-5a-1; they were merged.

validator_classification.note: Every runtime subject carries EITHER validator_owner (an explicit validator path/symbol/tool) OR validator_disposition (a bounded reason no generic validator applies). Generic values such as NONE, N/A or free-form prose are rejected by scripts/ci/check-config-format-coverage.sh R-8.

disposition_meaning.EXTERNAL_TOOL_SYNTAX: Syntax is owned by an external tool, not by an NFTBan validator (e.g. nft for an NFT_RULESET subject). Correctly refused by the generic assignment parser.
disposition_meaning.GENERATED_NO_OPERATOR_SCHEMA: Written by NFTBan at runtime, not authored by an operator, so no operator-facing schema applies.
disposition_meaning.KEY_SCHEMA_ONLY: Keys are declared in config-schema.json (verified present), but NO file-level validator executes against this subject. This is explicit assurance debt, not a clean state.
disposition_meaning.OPERATOR_DATA_NO_SCHEMA: Policy/data list (templates, delimited lists). Content is operator data, not NFTBAN_* settings, so the key schema does not apply.
disposition_meaning.STRUCTURED_DATA_NO_KEY_SCHEMA: Section-scoped structured data whose keys are deliberately outside the NFTBAN_* key schema.
